_comment: Project-scoped MCP wiring for developing MPM itself.
`command` intentionally points at the DEVELOPER artifact .build/bin/mpm-mcp,
never at $(PREFIX)/bin. A build must not be able to launch as the live server,
and a deploy must not be shadowed by a stale checkout artifact.
`MPM_WORKSPACE` points at the CANONICAL RUNTIME ROOT (${HOME}/.mpm), not at
`.`. The source checkout is not a workspace. Setting it to `.` made the
mpm-mcp server treat the checkout as a runtime workspace, and because
mpmcli.ResolveWorkspace() falls back to the literal `.` (internal/core/mpmcli/
mpmcli.go:18-23) the MCP server then bootstrap-created mode/ and persona/
inside the source tree and resolved its DB there — source pollution, and a
ghost database distinct from the canonical one.
`${HOME}` is used rather than `~` because MCP hosts expand `${VAR}` in the env
block but pass a literal tilde through unexpanded; a literal `~/.mpm` is a
relative path and would recreate the very bug this replaces. This was
verified empirically against the host, not assumed.
